page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with the running head above it and the catchword at lower right. No marginal notes can be read clearly; faint marks in the left margin are not legible text.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: utque quotannis de hoc tributo apud genero-
iisdem liceat vectigal cerevisiæ & vino in
illam stipendiis impendere, ac salariis offi-
riis: quod si tamen vectigal annuum excef-
serit aureos quatermille, excedens pars ut
cedat in erarium commune, ejusque quæsto-
ri numeretur. In hoc statu res ista hæsit,
novus est pulvis civitati excitatus: de quo
paulò post rursum. Anno verò M. DC. cùm
comitiis provinciæ, leges latæ sunt ab Or-
summa. Deputati in collegio sint vi. pari

l.i: numero utrimque lecti, patriæ amantes ac
fidi, viri integri, bonique nominis, religio-
ni reformatæ addicti, qui cum Gubernatore

page.notes: Catchword "colle-" at lower right. Faint marks in the left margin near the middle of the page are not legible and were not transcribed. Italic extent in the last sentence is read from the scan and may be slightly off. Printed "abOr-dinibus" and "quatermille" are as printed.
